sourceScope: 55 base plus trace-only overlay on ProcessSessionPage, BackgroundProcessManager and TerminalPipelineTrace; restore checkout after CI build

hypotheses.H1: For ordinary MAIN refresh, receive-to-capture wait is principally the registered frame-clock wait, not task launch or sync/resize guards.
hypotheses.H2: If the frame-clock continuation resumes only after the display frame's callbacks/traversal, the publication belongs outside that Choreographer frame and cannot update its already drawn content.
hypotheses.doNotConclude: This diagnosis alone cannot prove an optimization would improve latency or explain the rejected P2 arm's regression.

clock.diagnosticEvents: injected CLOCK_BOOTTIME through existing TerminalPipelineTrace capture
clock.productionResizeAndNotificationTime: unchanged System.nanoTime semantics; never compared with diagnostic BOOTTIME
clock.frameClockArgument: MONOTONIC vsync time, not a callback execution timestamp; not used as BOOTTIME

attribution.requestToJob: diagnostic request/enqueue to actual coroutine entry
attribution.frameWait: registration start, execution of existing withFrameNanos callback, and continuation after it returns are separate markers
attribution.syncWait: start/end of original synchronization guard; original completion Boolean retained
attribution.resizeWait: start/end of original resize branch; original flag retained
attribution.capture: existing FRAME_CAPTURE_STARTED, inserted marker after acquiring the original emulator monitor, FRAME_CAPTURED and ROW_SYNC events
attribution.presentation: optional same-row exact frame-identity evidence, not a gate for this scheduling diagnosis
attribution.cpu: same BOOTTIME scheduler intervals; nested sections cannot be added
attribution.flags: added marker Boolean uses existing optional virtual field and is also exported as flag; it is stage-specific, never a renderer claim
